definitions.explanation: What is left over after division, subtraction, or use. The portion that exceeds what is needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余|あま}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a bag from the leftover fabric.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余|あま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す。
examples.english: We will carry over the budget surplus to next year.

notes:
This entry covers the noun sense of {余|あま}り (remainder). The adverb ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧ (not very; too much) is a separate usage.

FORMS:
⟦{余|あま}る→余る：00001_amaru⟧ (to be left over) → {余|あま}り (the leftover part)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{算|ざん}→割り算：05335_warizan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余|あま}り: remainder in division
- {余|あま}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧: leftover fabric
- {余|あま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: there is a surplus

MATH USAGE:
In arithmetic, {余|あま}り indicates the remainder: 7÷2＝3{余|あま}り1.
